snippet.title: Pandamonium Puzzle Teaser
snippet.description:
Check out this free mobile match-3 game with no Ads.  Available on both Google Play and the App Store. #15seconds #indiedev #match3 #mobilegame #freetoplay 

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.GoldenCharacterDesign.PandamoniumPuzzle
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pandamonium-puzzle/id6503724864

Made with so many personal touches and unique attributes!  You can even add your own images!

Try it and share it!

If you love the game as much as we think you will, you can support us with the optional theme set purchases to add extra animations and objects to the game.
